summary.headline: Signification of the Three Superiors
summary.text: Discussion of Saturn’s role in regional distress, royal misfortune, military strength, victory, planetary testimonies, profections, and changes of sects and kingdoms. Chapter XXII begins by explaining the significance of Saturn, Jupiter, and Mars, including their conjunctions, triplicities, positions relative to fixed, movable, and common signs, and the revolution of the years.
